items.source: Your configuration still has to extend the AbstractCouchbaseConfiguration, but since RBAC (role-based access control) is now mandatory, different properties need to be overridden in order to be configured: getConnectionString, getUserName, getPassword and getBucketName.If you want to use a non-default scope optionally you can override the getScopeName method.Note that if you want to use certificate based authentication or you need to customize the password authentication, the authenticator method can be overridden to perform this task.
items.translation: 您的配置仍然需要扩展AbstractCouchbaseConfiguration，但由于基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）现已成为强制要求，必须重写不同的属性以进行配置：getConnectionString、getUserName、getPassword和getBucketName。如果您想可选地使用非默认的作用域，可以重写getScopeName方法。请注意，如果您想使用基于证书的认证或需要自定义密码认证，可以重写authenticator方法来执行此任务。

items.source: Since the Couchbase SDK 3 removes support for RxJava and instead adds support for Reactor, both the couchbaseTemplate as well as the reactiveCouchbaseTemplate can be directly accessed from the AbstractCouchbaseConfiguration.
items.translation: 由于 Couchbase SDK 3 移除了对 RxJava 的支持，转而增加了对 Reactor 的支持，因此可以直接从 AbstractCouchbaseConfiguration 访问 couchbaseTemplate 和 reactiveCouchbaseTemplate。

items.source: Automatic Index Management has been redesigned to allow more flexible indexing. New annotations have been introduced and old ones like @ViewIndexed, @N1qlSecondaryIndexed and @N1qlPrimaryIndexed were removed.
items.translation: 自动索引管理已重新设计，以支持更灵活的索引。现已引入新的注解，并移除了旧有的@ViewIndexed、@N1qlSecondaryIndexed和@N1qlPrimaryIndexed等注解。

items.source: org.springframework.data.couchbase.repository.ReactiveCouchbaseSortingRepository has been removed.Consider extending ReactiveSortingRepository or ReactiveCouchbaseRepository
items.translation: org.springframework.data.couchbase.repository.ReactiveCouchbaseSortingRepository 已被移除。请考虑扩展 ReactiveSortingRepository 或 ReactiveCouchbaseRepository。

items.source: org.springframework.data.couchbase.repository.CouchbasePagingAndSortingRepository has been removed.Consider extending PagingAndSortingRepository or CouchbaseRepository
items.translation: org.springframework.data.couchbase.repository.CouchbasePagingAndSortingRepository 已被移除。请考虑扩展 PagingAndSortingRepository 或 CouchbaseRepository。

items.source: The method getCouchbaseOperations() has also been removed. You can still access all methods from the native Java SDK via the class CouchbaseTemplate or Cluster:
items.translation: `getCouchbaseOperations()` 方法也已移除。您仍可通过 `CouchbaseTemplate` 或 `Cluster` 类访问原生 Java SDK 中的所有方法：

items.source: The new SDK still has an environment that is used to configure it, so you can override the configureEnvironment method and supply custom configuration if needed.
items.translation: 新 SDK 仍保留了一个用于配置其的环境，因此您可以重写 `configureEnvironment` 方法，并在需要时提供自定义配置。

items.source: For more information, see Installation & Configuration.
items.translation: 有关更多信息，请参阅安装与配置。

items.source: The org.springframework.data.couchbase.core.mapping.Document annotation stayed the same.
items.translation: org.springframework.data.couchbase.core.mapping.Document 注解保持不变。

items.source: For more information, see Modeling Entities.
items.translation: 有关更多信息，请参阅建模实体。

items.source: For more information, see Automatic Index Management.
items.translation: 有关更多信息，请参阅自动索引管理。

items.source: For more information, see Template & direct operations.
items.translation: 有关更多信息，请参阅模板和直接操作。

items.source: It is possible to override the default scan consistency for N1QL queries through the new ScanConsistency annotation.
items.translation: 可以通过新的 `ScanConsistency` 注解覆盖 N1QL 查询的默认扫描一致性。

items.source: See Couchbase repositories for more information.
items.translation: 有关更多信息，请参阅Couchbase 存储库。

items.source: The FTS API has been simplified and now can be accessed via the Cluster class:
items.translation: FTS API 现已简化，可通过 Cluster 类进行访问：

items.source: See the FTS Documentation for more information.
items.translation: 有关更多信息，请参阅全文搜索文档。

items.source: This chapter is a quick reference of what major changes have been introduced in 4.x and gives a high-level overview of things to consider when migrating.
items.translation: 本章是 4.x 版本引入的主要变更的快速参考指南，并提供了迁移时需要考虑事项的高级概述。

items.source: Please note that implicitly the minimum Couchbase Server version has been bumped up to 5.5 and later, and we recommend running at least 6.0.x.
items.translation: 请注意，Couchbase Server 的最低版本已隐式提升至 5.5 及以上，我们建议至少运行 6.0.x 版本。

items.source: Since the main objective was to migrate from the Java SDK 2 to 3, configuration has changed to adapt to the new SDK and also in the long run to prepare it for scopes and collections (but it can still be used without collection support).
items.translation: 由于主要目标是从 Java SDK 2 迁移到 SDK 3，配置已进行调整以适应新 SDK，并长期来看为支持范围和集合做好准备（尽管仍可在不支持集合的情况下使用）。

items.source: Spring Boot 2.3.x or higher depends on Spring Data Couchbase 4.x.Earlier versions of Couchbase are not available because SDK 2 and 3 cannot live on the same classpath.
items.translation: Spring Boot 2.3.x 或更高版本依赖于 Spring Data Couchbase 4.x。由于 SDK 2 和 SDK 3 无法共存于同一个类路径中，因此不支持早期版本的 Couchbase。

items.source: How to deal with entities has not changed, although since the SDK now does not ship annotations anymore only Spring-Data related annotations are supported.
items.translation: 处理实体（entity）的方式并未改变，尽管自 SDK 不再提供注解以来，仅支持 Spring Data 相关的注解。

items.source: The template has been completely overhauled so that it now uses a fluent API to configure instead of many method overloads.This has the advantage that in the future we are able to extend the functionality without having to introduce more and more overloads that make it complicated to navigate.
items.translation: 模板已彻底重构，现在采用流式 API 进行配置，而非众多方法重载。其优势在于，未来我们能够在不引入越来越多使导航变得复杂的重载的情况下扩展功能。

items.translation: 下表描述了 3.x 中的方法名称及其与 4.x 中对应版本的比较：

items.translation: 此外，还新增了以下在 3.x 版本中不可用的方法：

items.source: Allows to remove entities through a N1QL query
items.translation: 允许通过 N1QL 查询删除实体。

items.source: Performs a find through the analytics service
items.translation: 通过分析服务执行查找操作。

items.source: Like findById, but takes replicas into account
items.translation: 与 findById 类似，但会考虑副本。

items.source: We tried to unify and align the APIs more closely to the underlying SDK semantics so they are easier to correlate and navigate.
items.translation: 我们努力使 API 与底层 SDK 的语义更加统一和一致，以便于关联和导航。

items.source: The behavior itself has not changed over the previous version on how the query derivation is supposed to work. Should you encounter any queries that worked in the past and now do not work anymore please let us know.
items.translation: 行为本身在查询推导的工作方式上并未随上一版本发生变化。如果您遇到过去可以运行但现在无法运行的查询，请告知我们。
